title: Computing Robustness to Sparse Diagonal Uncertainty
summary: A new robustness metric $ν$ was recently proposed as a substitute for the structured singular value $μ$ to better capture robustness to sparse diagonal uncertainty, but its computation has remained an open problem. In this paper, we show that computing $ν$ is equivalent to maximizing the spectral radius of a nonnegative matrix product. This equivalence allows us to transfer existing results on spectral-radius maximization to $ν$, including a refined upper bound and conditions under which the bounds coincide.
